target.title: refactor: dedupe small async primitives
target.body:
Closes #105956

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves duplicated promise memoization and an unused hand-rolled SQLite connection mutex that made small async invariants harder to maintain consistently.

## Why This Change Was Made

The media-understanding copies now share one tiny promise-memo helper. The unused executable node:sqlite Kysely driver is reduced to its supported compile-only role; synchronous execution stays in the existing helper, and unsupported direct async execution still fails immediately. Domain-specific queues, reconcile trackers, and retry-aware caches remain separate.

The plugin-SDK deferred duplicate was already fixed on `main` by #99755, so its public API and hashed SDK baseline are unchanged here.

## User Impact

No intended user-visible behavior change. Maintainers get one canonical implementation for the duplicated media memo pattern and 226 fewer non-test lines.

## Evidence

- Final-head Testbox `tbx_01kxcvz8x7vt28h2kqjq6nwqzb` ([run 29224223364](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29224223364)): full `pnpm check:loc` and `pnpm lint:kysely` passed.
- Same exact-head Testbox: 70/70 focused SQLite, shared-helper, and media-understanding tests passed across three Vitest shards.
- `pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check` was run; it reports pre-existing `main` baseline drift, while this branch has no plugin-SDK diff.
- `pnpm test:changed` completed the visible test matrix green but ended with an unrelated Vitest worker exit in a gateway shard; focused touched-surface proof is clean.
- Fresh branch autoreview: no accepted/actionable findings, patch correct at 0.94 confidence.
- `git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD`: non-test +57/-283, net -226 lines.

AI assistance: implementation, tests, and review were performed with Codex under maintainer direction.
